reviewerRecords.organisation: American Economic Association (hosted by American University)
reviewerRecords.program: AEA Summer Training and Scholarship Program 2027
reviewerRecords.evidenceExcerpt: Dates: May 31 - July 23, 2027. Application Deadline: January 31, 2027. The application portal for the 2027 AEA Summer Program is now open. ... Email aeasp@american.edu. (FAQ) Everyone is eligible to apply regardless of ethnicity ... no other classes, part-time jobs, or other commitments are allowed.
reviewerRecords.deadline: Sun 31 Jan 2027 (weekday verified; time and timezone not stated); acceptances early March 2027
reviewerRecords.audience: Undergraduates and recent graduates (also BA/MA holders) planning an economics PhD
reviewerRecords.eligibility: Designed for students who would bring greater diversity to the profession, but everyone may apply regardless of ethnicity; no economics PhD; ideally GPA 3.0+ and calculus, statistics and microeconomics taken; interested in a doctoral degree. International students may apply.
reviewerRecords.funding: US citizens and permanent residents receive a $3,250 stipend; tuition, housing and books covered. International students get no stipend and pay about $25,000 themselves (FAQ).
reviewerRecords.duration: 8 weeks, Mon 31 May - Fri 23 Jul 2027 (weekdays verified); full-time, no other classes, jobs or commitments
questionsForOutreach: Is a research-experienced applicant still a good fit for the programme?
reviewerRecords.notes: FIT: broad. Economics PhD pipeline in DC, fully funded for US citizens/PRs. Diversity-oriented but explicitly open to all. Needs the full 8 weeks free. Application portal not opened.
